name: 39452 · Lucedale, MS
findings: ZIP 39452 (Lucedale) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39452 (Lucedale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39452 (Lucedale) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
